items.docs: JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint for the MCP server. Set `method` to `tools/call` and `params.name` to one of `getAccountBalance`, `getAccountHistory`, `getUserCards`, `getUserCardTransactions`, `getCardRevealPublicKey`. Pick a tool from the request examples below. The tool's payload comes back as a JSON-encoded string in `result.content[0].text`.
